'''Lycus Mattle''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia" /> [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was present on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] outside [[Nem'ro's Palace]] during [[Cipher Nine]]'s undercover mission as "[[Red Blade]]."
